scope: Melee chain, charge, interruption, animation and owner permissions; analysis metadata only
snapshot_note: M8 work was ongoing; re-read stable handoff before implementation.
classification_note: Syntactic inventory, not a recovery percentage or runtime equivalence. Nonempty bodies include calls to missing callees and may remain incomplete.

facts.statement: WeaponSkill is a secondary class extending OldSkill, not Skill.
The base charge-turn permission returns true.
TPSword returns false for charge-turn permission.
WiggleWhip returns false for charge-turn permission.
Cycle zero dispatches critical-feedback cleanup before cycle assignment; scheduler is unavailable.
If nextIsChargeAtk is set, interruption dispatches missing dynamic-charge execution before missing base interrupt.
cancelDashCharge calls interrupt before clearing nextIsChargeAtk.
Club divides trueChargeF by 60 for seconds; no charge threshold is established.
Cancellation stores byWeapon before delegation; fixedUpdate clears that flag after base update.
Cycle assignment writes sharedCycle when share is true; otherwise delegates to missing base setter.
Cycle-loss query checks owner cooldown key 1451229184; no expiry duration or expanded key meaning inferred.
Chain cancellation delegates then clears prevSkillInf; rhythm timing/input logic are missing.
PureNail reports false to isPlayingAttackAnim; no general permission/movement rule follows without consumers.
World-ammo registration destroys existing entity before replacement. Chain cancel cleans live world ammo and linked entity.
Timed suspension stores frames plus one. Missing update prevents deriving effective gameplay pause duration.
Opponent contact dispatches to missing tryHitEntities; Skill is not WeaponSkill's base.
